summary: This Form 8-K filed by Ryerson Holding Corporation reports routine quarterly financial results under Item 2.02 and declares a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.1875 per share payable June 18, 2026. No M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing also references the prior integration of Olympic Steel but provides no new transaction terms, advisor involvement, or structural mechanics. It is a standard earnings release with a dividend announcement, not a special situation.
